title: After the Nikkei Shinshun Hai: A Whole New Me ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff, pant! Phew… Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Zoom! Straight out the gate! Let's… GOOO! WAAAHEEEEEY! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She runs without any hesitation, her form infused with the same party energy as her introduction. It feels good just watching her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may have blossomed a little late, but she's finally come into her own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haha! Looks like everyone's starting to thaw out. Let's see if I can't really fire them up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mejiro?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Palmer?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Woohooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Waheeeeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even the fans who were confused at the start are now completely taken by her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She makes the race a real party and steals the audience's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aw yeah! That gave me life!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Heck yeah, bestie!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thanks, you guuuys! This is it! This is what I've been looking for!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: This is the kinda running that yeets the pressure off!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's like I'm living for the first time! And life is liiit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nothing scares me anymore! I feel like I can go anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Come again?
choice_data_list: Is there really nothing that scares you now?
Is there really nothing that scares you now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm, not that I can think of… I mean, I'm kinda on a runner's high right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she's truly no longer scared by anything, then there's no reason to hold back. I think it's high time to set her next race, and for that…
choice_data_list: Then let's tackle the spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho… That means…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'll be up against McQueen! And possibly Ryan! And on top of that…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho is, like, super duper, mega huge… Not to mention really important to my family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And you want me to run there? No cap?
choice_data_list: No cap. If you're up for it, that is.
No cap. If you're up for it, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And you want me to run it just like today? Full on me, loud and proud?
choice_data_list: I can't think of a better place for you to flaunt your true self.
I can't think of a better place for you to flaunt your true self.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Should I seriously do it at the spring Tenno Sho? But I'm pretty sure… Actually, I'm absolutely sure…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: …Granny Mejiro's gonna be there! Can I really do that in front of her? Like for real?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wait for Mejiro Palmer's reaction. I'm not going to force her to run in this race. After all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stipulation for her to compete in it is that she must run it with a full heart. I watch as she mulls it over…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Just thinking about that took some years off my life… But…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right… I'll… I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'll run… I wanna see how far I can go.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: For real, Palmster?! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You got this for sure! You're the best there is! Yodo's got nothin' on you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Don't hold back one little bit! Kick butts, take names, and win like mad! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm in. I'll do it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No better way to be me than to go off at the spring Tenno Sho! I'm literally shaking, but let's goooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer, trembling with fear and excitement for the unknown, has decided to run in the spring Tenno Sho.
